title: Data Questions
prompt: Given `std::vector<int> v`, implement `sorted_desc(v)` (new vector, sorted descending), `count_above(v, t)` (number of elements > t), and `sum_of_evens(v)` (sum of even elements). Empty input: empty vector / 0 / 0.

tests.name: desc order
tests.hint: Sort with a greater-than comparator; do not mutate the input.
